candidates.topic: Saturn Retrograde Conjunct Moon in Aries
candidates.teaser: Saturn and the Moon are sitting at almost the exact same degree in Aries right now — and most people have no idea what that tension is building toward.
candidates.video_title: Saturn Is Right Next to the Moon in Aries Today
candidates.video_description: Saturn retrograde and the Moon are conjunct in Aries at nearly the same degree right now. This rare pressure point hits fire and cardinal signs hardest. Here's what it means for you.
candidates.script: Saturn and the Moon are sitting at almost the same degree in Aries right now — and that is not a gentle combination. In astrology, Saturn is the planet of restriction, karma, and hard lessons. The Moon rules your emotions and instincts. When these two collide in warrior Aries, astrologers say the push to act fast crashes directly into a wall that forces you to slow down and reckon with something old. With Saturn retrograde, that wall is internal — something unresolved is asking to be faced. Aries, Libra, Cancer, Capricorn — you feel this the most. What are you refusing to deal with?

candidates.topic: Three Planets Retrograde at Once — Saturn, Neptune, Pluto
candidates.teaser: Three planets are retrograde simultaneously right now, and the combination of which ones they are is genuinely rare — here's why astrologers are paying close attention.
candidates.video_title: 3 Planets Retrograde Right Now — This Combo Is Rare
candidates.video_description: Saturn, Neptune, and Pluto are all retrograde at the same time. Each one rules a completely different layer of life — structure, illusion, and transformation. Together, the pressure is layered and deep.
candidates.script: Three planets are retrograde right now — and the specific three matters. Saturn, Neptune, and Pluto are all moving backward simultaneously. In astrology, Saturn retrograde forces a reckoning with your foundations. Neptune retrograde pulls back the fog — things you idealized or denied start becoming undeniably clear. Pluto retrograde digs into power, control, and what you can no longer avoid transforming. When all three align like this, astrologers describe it as pressure coming from every level at once — structure, illusion, and depth. The question isn't whether you feel it. It's whether you're listening.

candidates.topic: Sun and Mercury Both in Virgo — Cazimi Energy
candidates.teaser: The Sun and Mercury are only three degrees apart in Virgo right now — in astrology, this closeness is one of the most powerful mental states a chart can hold.
candidates.video_title: Sun and Mercury Are Almost Exact in Virgo Right Now
candidates.video_description: With the Sun at 8° Virgo and Mercury at 11° Virgo, these two are in an extremely tight conjunction. Astrologers call near-exact Sun-Mercury alignments cazimi — a state of heightened mental clarity and expression.
candidates.script: The Sun is at 8 degrees Virgo and Mercury is at 11 degrees Virgo right now — and astrologers pay very close attention when these two get this close. There's a concept called cazimi, from ancient astrology, where a planet sitting extremely near the Sun is said to be supercharged rather than burned out. Mercury rules the mind, communication, and analysis. Virgo rules precision, health, and systems. Together, this window is traditionally read as one of the sharpest mental alignments of the year. If you've been overthinking — that energy has somewhere to actually go right now.

candidates.topic: What Your Rising Sign Actually Does (vs. Sun Sign)
candidates.teaser: Most people check their Sun sign — but astrologers argue your Rising sign is the one that actually shapes how your entire life unfolds.
candidates.video_title: Your Rising Sign Does More Than You Think
candidates.video_description: Your Sun sign is your core identity — but your Rising sign, also called the Ascendant, sets the entire structure of your birth chart. It determines which houses govern which areas of your life.
candidates.script: Everyone knows their Sun sign — but in astrology, your Rising sign is arguably doing more work than any other placement. Your Rising sign, also called the Ascendant, is the zodiac degree that was on the horizon the exact moment you were born. It doesn't just describe how others see you — it sets the entire layout of your birth chart, determining which house rules your money, your relationships, your career, your fears. Change your Rising sign, and every area of life shifts position. So before you read another horoscope — do you actually know yours?

candidates.topic: Venus in Libra — Its Own Sign and What That Means
candidates.teaser: Venus just moved into the one sign it actually rules — and in astrology, a planet in its home sign operates completely differently than anywhere else.
candidates.video_title: Venus Is in Its Own Sign Right Now — Here's Why That Matters
candidates.video_description: Venus is currently in Libra, the sign it rules. In astrology, a planet in domicile — its home sign — expresses its purest and most powerful energy. For love, beauty, and balance, this is one of the most favorable Venus placements of the year.
candidates.script: Venus is currently in Libra — and that's not just a regular transit. Libra is the sign Venus actually rules, which means in astrology this is called a domicile placement — Venus is home. A planet in its home sign doesn't have to fight against foreign energy. It expresses exactly what it's built for. Venus in Libra is traditionally read as peak energy for charm, aesthetic clarity, partnership, and the kind of beauty that feels effortless. For air signs especially, astrologers say this window opens something in your social and romantic world that's been waiting. Are you paying attention to it?
